blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: How do diffusion transformers (DiTs) represent image content and learn rules for reusing it to generalize? We develop an aggregator--predictor view of DiTs as input-adaptive local denoisers, in which context aggregation and patch prediction provide functional roles for interpreting attention and MLPs. We first establish that, for Gaussian Markov random field (GMRF) priors, the global Bayes denoiser can be approximated using only a subset of context patches, with error decaying exponentially in context radius. We further show that patchwise linear denoisers, often invoked to explain diffusion generalization, recover the empirical local denoiser with sufficiently informative aggregation. Within this view, AdaLN-modulated attention naturally parameterizes an input- and noise-dependent aggregator, while the MLP admits a learned key--value representation for tokenwise patch prediction. Our experiments support this view. DiTs trained on real images exhibit noise-dependent denoising contexts resembling those in the analytic GMRF setting, while attention mass exhibits a qualitatively corresponding broadening pattern. In a controlled CelebA64 study, shared-memory patch predictors used in place of DiT MLPs achieve competitive denoising and generative performance. Finally, cross-dataset component transplantation reveals compatibility patterns consistent with the proposed roles of QK in spatial weighting, VO in feature transport, and MLPs in patch prediction. Together, these results provide a component-level account of DiT denoising and motivate architecture-specific fine-tuning and controlled intervention.
blocks.zh: 扩散变压器(DiTs)如何代表图像内容并学习重用它来概括的规则? 我们开发一种聚合-前导视图,将 DiTs 视为可输入-可适应的本地阴极,其中上下文聚合和补丁预测提供了解释注意力和MLP的功能作用. 我们首先确定,对于高斯·马尔可夫随机字段(GMRF)前传,全球Bayes denoiser可以仅使用上下文补丁的子集进行近似化,误差在上下文半径上成指数地衰变. 我们进一步显示, 补丁线性阴茎, 经常被引用来解释扩散一般化, 用足够的信息聚合来恢复经验性的地方阴茎。 在这个观点中,AdaLN调制的注意力自然参数化了一个依赖输入和噪声的聚合器,而MLP则承认了一种学习到的按键-值表示,用于象征性的补丁预测. 我们的实验支持这一观点。 接受过真实图像培训的DiT显示与分析性GMRF环境相似的依赖噪声的去诺环境,而关注量则显示质量上相应的扩大模式。 在一项受控制的CelebA64研究中,用来代替 DiT MLP 的共享-memory补丁预测器实现竞争性去诺能和基因分泌性能. 最后,跨数据集组件移植揭示出与QK在空间权重设定中的拟议作用相符合的相容性模式,特征迁移中的VO,以及补丁预测中的MLP. 这些结果共同提供了DiT调制和激励特定架构的微调和控制干预的组件级账户.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Diffusion and flow-matching models are widely used for image generation ( Song et al., 2021 ; Lipman et al., 2023 ) , with Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) becoming a standard backbone ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; Esser et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Li and He, 2026 ) .
Growing evidence connects their generalization to representations of images and rules for reusing them .
Diffusion features encode semantic and geometric information ( Baranchuk et al., 2022 ; Tang et al., 2023 ) , and aligning them with pretrained representations improves training ( Yu et al., 2025 ) .
Models also generate combinations absent from the training data, as shown by analyses of synthetic hierarchical data ( Okawa et al., 2023 ; Favero et al., 2025 ) .
How components of DiTs realize these capabilities remains unclear.
blocks.zh:
扩散和流配模型被广泛用于图像生成(Song et al., 2021; Lipman et al., 2023),其中扩散变换器(DiTs)成为标准的骨干(Peebles and Xie, 2023; Esser et al., 2024; Xie et al., 2025; Li and He, 2026).
越来越多的证据将图像的概括与图像的表达和重用规则联系起来。
传播特征编码语义和几何信息(Baranchuk等人,2022年;Tang等人,2023年),并使其与经过预先培训的表述相一致,改进了培训(Yu等人,2025年)。
模型还生成培训数据中缺失的组合,如合成等级数据分析所示(Okawa等人,2023年;Favero等人,2025年)。
DiTs的组件如何实现这些能力仍然不清楚.

blocks.en:
Existing explanations connect diffusion-model generalization to geometry-adaptive harmonic or balanced representations ( Kadkhodaie et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and inductive biases toward spatial locality and translation equivariance ( Kamb and Ganguli, 2025 ; Niedoba et al., 2025 ) .
These accounts leave open how DiT components divide the denoising computation. Rosu et al. (2025) show that attention can implement exact score-based denoising, but they consider whole-image tokens, leaving interactions among spatial patches unresolved. An et al. (2025) associate DiT generalization with attention mimicking CNN-like spatial locality, but attention can also select input-dependent, spatially non-contiguous context (Sec. 5.1 ).
We ask: How do attention, MLPs, and adaptive layer normalization (AdaLN) divide the work of representing image content and learning context-dependent rules for generalization?
blocks.zh:
现有解释将传播模式的概括化与几何适应谐音或均衡表示联系起来(Kadkhodaie等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2026年),以及对空间位置和翻译等效的诱导偏差(Kamb and Ganguli,2025年;Niedoba等人,2025年)。
这些账户未打开 DiT 组件如何分割去名计算 。 Rosu等人(2025年)表示,注意力可以实施精确的计分代号,但他们考虑的是全像符,使得空间补丁之间的相互作用无法解决. An等人(2025年)将DiT泛化与注意模仿CNN相似的空间位置联系起来,但注意还可以选择依赖输入,空间上下无毗连的上下文(Sec.5.1).
我们问:关注、MLPs和适应层正常化(AdaLN)如何将代表图像内容和学习上下文规则的工作分割开来?

blocks.en:
Understanding these component roles matters for intervention: domain adaptation, concept editing, and controlled generation require deciding which computations to modify and which to preserve.
In language models, interpreting MLPs as key–value memories has motivated methods for editing stored associations ( Geva et al., 2021 ; Meng et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2023 ) , with related analyses in multimodal transformers ( Pan et al., 2024a ; Basu et al., 2024a ) .
A functional account of DiTs could similarly guide component-wise adaptation across domains and interventions that change image content while preserving desired spatial relationships.
Related work is reviewed in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
理解这些组成角色对干预很重要:域调整,概念编辑,以及控制生成都需要决定要修改的计算和要保存的计算.
在语言模型中,将MLP解释为关键值记忆,激发了编辑存储关联的方法(Geva等人,2021年;Meng等人,2022年;Meng等人,2023年),并用多式联运变压器进行相关分析(Pan等人,2024年a; Basu等人, 2024a).
DiTs的功能账户同样可以指导不同领域和干预的构件适应,改变图像内容,同时维护理想的空间关系。
附录A审查了有关工作。

blocks.en: We address this question by proposing an aggregator–predictor view of DiTs as input-adaptive local denoisers , supported by a statistical foundation and a set of architectural and empirical observations:
blocks.zh: 我们通过提出DiTs作为输入性适应性本地词条的集合者-predictor观点来解决这个问题,并辅以统计基础和一系列建筑和经验观察:

blocks.en:
(1) A statistical foundation for local denoising. We justify local denoiser, in which each patch is denoised using only a subset of context patches, by identifying its statistical target and establishing when it approximates the global Bayes denoiser.
Specifically, for Gaussian Markov random field (GMRF) image priors, the global denoiser can be approximated by a radius- r r local denoiser with error decaying exponentially in r r (Thm. 1 ).
We further connect existing patchwise retrieval-based explanations of generalization to this target by showing that, with sufficiently informative aggregation, a patchwise linear denoiser exactly recovers the empirical local denoiser (Thm. 3 ).
blocks.zh:
(1) 地方代言的统计基础。 我们为本地的Denoiser辩护,其中每个补丁只使用一个子集的上下文补丁,方法是确定其统计目标,并确定其大致相当于全球的Bayes Denoiser。
具体来说,对于Gaussian Markov随机场(GMRF)的图像前传,全球的denoiser可以被半径(r r local denoiser,错误衰减指数为r(Thm. 1 ))所近似.
我们进一步将现有的基于补丁检索的概括性解释与这个目标联系起来,表明,通过足够的信息汇总,一个补丁线性除尘器完全恢复了经验性的局部除尘器(Thm. 3 )。

blocks.en:
(2) An aggregator–predictor interpretation of DiT components. We decompose the local denoising into context aggregation followed by patch prediction (Def. 2 ).
Under this view, the algebraic structure of AdaLN-modulated attention implements an input- and noise-dependent aggregation rule: QK parameterizes spatial compatibility weights, while VO transforms the corresponding features (Sec. 4.1 ).
In turn, MLP admits a key–value memory interpretation and operates on the resulting contextualized token (Sec. 4.2 ).
These algebraic correspondences are exact for the isolated branches considered in Sec. 4 ; in a multilayer residual stack, the proposed roles interact and need not remain functionally separable (Appendix D.5 ).
This view extends existing fixed spatial-locality accounts by allowing the relevant context to depend on the image and noise level and to include spatially non-contiguous patches.
It further suggests the possibility of replacing DiT MLPs with more interpretable memory-based components, as supported by our experiments (Sec. 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
(2) DiT组件的汇总-主解释. 我们将本地解析为上下文汇总,然后是补丁预测(第2项)。
在此观点下,AdaLN调制的注意的代数结构执行一个输入和噪声依赖的聚合规则:QK参数化空间兼容权重,而VO则转换相应的特征(Sec 4.1.
反过来,MLP承认一个键 - 值内存解释,并在由此产生的上下文符号上操作(Sec. 4.2)。
这些代数通信对于 Sec. 4 中考虑的孤立分支来说是精确的;在一个多层的剩余堆栈中,拟议角色相互作用,不需要保持功能分离(Appendix D.5 ).
这种观点通过允许相关上下文依赖于图像和噪声水平,并包括空间上非毗连的补丁,扩展了现有的固定空间-位置账户.
它进一步提出了用更可解释的内存组件取代DiT MLP的可能性,这得到了我们的实验的支持(Sec 5.2. ).

blocks.en:
(3) Empirical evidence consistent with the proposed component roles. Across real-image datasets, DiT sensitivity fields exhibit noise-dependent context broadening resembling the GMRF setting, while attention mass shows a related qualitative trend (Sec. 5.1 ).
We further construct explicit shared-memory patch predictors that retain competitive denoising and generation performance in a controlled CelebA64 study (Sec. 5.2 ).
Finally, cross-domain component transplantation reveals systematic component-compatibility patterns associated with source–target spatial similarity. These patterns are consistent with, but do not uniquely identify, the proposed roles in context aggregation and patch prediction (Sec. 5.3 ).
blocks.zh:
(3) 符合拟议组成部分作用的经验证据。 在整个真实图像数据集中,DiT敏感域呈现出与噪声相关的环境,与GMRF设置类似,而关注质量则显示出相关的质量趋势(Sec.5.1)。
我们还在一项受控制的CelebA64研究(第5.2节)中构建了明确的共享模组补丁预测器,以保留竞争性去诺和生成性能。
最后,跨域组件移植揭示了与源-目标空间相似性相关的系统性组件兼容性模式. 这些模式与上下文汇总和补丁预测中的拟议作用一致,但并不独具特色(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: 3 Local denoiser can approximate global denoiser
blocks.zh: 3 本地代号可以大致显示为全球代号

blocks.en:
We first show when global denoising can be accurately approximated using only a local subset of patches.

blocks.en:
A single attention branch separates QK spatial weighting from VO value transformation and mixing ( 7 ).
The QK projections determine the compatibility scores of patches through ( W ~ h Q ) ⊤ ​ W ~ h K (\tilde{W}_{h}^{Q})^{\top}\tilde{W}_{h}^{K} , and softmax converts these scores into spatial weights.
By smoothly suppressing patches with low relative scores, attention performs soft thresholding and forms an approximately local aggregator when its weights concentrate on a suitable context.
In this branch-level sense, QK parameterizes which patch positions receive greater or smaller weight in the constructed context, depending on image content, position, and noise level.
Appendix D.3 details the local approximation.

单关注分支将QK空间权重与VO值转换和混合(7 )分离.
QK预测确定补丁通过(W ~ h Q) → W ~ h K (\tilde{W}_{h}^{Q}}) → Top}\tilde{W}_{h}^{K}的兼容分数,软马克思将这些分数转换成空间权重.
通过平稳压制相对分数低的补丁,注意力执行软阈值,并在重心集中在适当的上下文时形成大约局部的集合器.
在这个分支级别意义上,QK参数化了哪些补丁位置在构造上下文中获得的比重大小,这取决于图像内容、位置和噪音级别。
附录D.3详细介绍了当地近似情况.

blocks.en:
VO transforms and combines the selected features through the shared, time-dependent channel operators diag ⁡ ( α ~ t ) ​ W ~ h O ​ W ~ h V \operatorname{diag}(\tilde{\alpha}_{t})\tilde{W}_{h}^{O}\tilde{W}_{h}^{V} .
Attention thus combines H ~ \tilde{H} shared channel operators with input-dependent spatial weights, rather than learning an independent operator for every patch pair.
This decomposition motivates an aggregator interpretation: for fixed input features, QK directly controls relative spatial weights, while VO applies patch-shared channel operators to the weighted features.
The downstream impact of an attention weight also depends on the value features, channel operators, and residual interactions.
These roles interact through learned features and across layers, but the distinction motivates examining QK and VO separately in Sec. 5.3 .

blocks.en: 4.2 MLP and shared-memory patch predictors
blocks.zh: 4.2 MLP和共享元件补丁预测器

blocks.en:
Within the single-layer model, the DiT MLP g t mlp g_{t}^{\mathrm{mlp}} acts on the attention-aggregated context s = 𝒮 m , t attn ​ ( Y t ) s=\mathcal{S}_{m,t}^{\mathrm{attn}}(Y_{t}) in the patch-predictor role; in a residual stack, its output is a tokenwise feature update.
The framework also allows alternative patch predictors, such as the RBF predictor g m , t rbf g_{m,t}^{\mathrm{rbf}} in ( 5 ), which explicitly retrieves from training patches.
In a multilayer residual stack (Appendix D.5 ), these predictors can share memory across layers, just as g m , t rbf g_{m,t}^{\mathrm{rbf}} would consult the same training patches at each layer.
This motivates a sequence of shared-memory patch predictors connecting explicit patch retrieval to an ordinary MLP.
We present simplified forms below; Appendix D.4 gives the full parameterizations, including biases, output gates, compatibility projections, and multiple heads.

We first note that g t mlp g_{t}^{\mathrm{mlp}} and g m , t rbf g_{m,t}^{\mathrm{rbf}} admit similar key–value memory interpretations ( Geva et al., 2021 ) .
If coupled with the attention aggregator, g m , t rbf g_{m,t}^{\mathrm{rbf}} retrieves from patch-specific values { x m ( i ) } 1 : n \{x_{m}^{(i)}\}_{1:n} using contextualized training images 𝒮 m , t attn ​ ( x ( i ) ) \mathcal{S}_{m,t}^{\mathrm{attn}}(x^{(i)}) as keys.
A transformer MLP of hidden width R R likewise consists of learnable key–value pairs { k ( r ) , v ( r ) ∈ ℝ d h } r = 1 R \{k^{(r)},v^{(r)}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}}\}_{r=1}^{R} .
In DiTs, AdaLN modulates the memory query to produce time-dependent retrieval weights: g t mlp ​ ( s ) \displaystyle g^{\mathrm{mlp}}_{t}(s) = ∑ r = 1 R gelu ⁡ ( AdaLN t ⁡ ( s ) ⊤ ​ k ( r ) ) ​ v ( r ) . \displaystyle=\sum_{r=1}^{R}\operatorname{gelu}\!\left(\operatorname{AdaLN}_{t}(s)^{\top}k^{(r)}\right)v^{(r)}. (8) Compared with g m , t rbf g_{m,t}^{\mathrm{rbf}} in ( 5 ), there are three differences: (i) the memory is learned rather than drawn from training patches, (ii) the same bank of memory is used across patches, and (iii) the retrieval weights are unnormalized and may have either sign.
These differences motivate three patch-predictor variants that start from g m , t rbf g_{m,t}^{\mathrm{rbf}} and progressively resemble g t mlp g_{t}^{\mathrm{mlp}} : we first make the memory learnable, then share it across patches, and finally replace normalized retrieval weights with unnormalized, potentially signed coefficients.

Compared to PLD, the first variant ( 9 ) replaces the training images with a learned memory bank { z ( r ) ∈ ℝ M ​ d h ′ } r = 1 R \{z^{(r)}\in\mathbb{R}^{Md_{h}^{\prime}}\}_{r=1}^{R} shared across layers, and RBF retrieval with softmax.
Just as a training image x ( i ) x^{(i)} consists of M M patches, each memory entry z ( r ) z^{(r)} consists of M M learnable patches z m ( r ) ∈ ℝ d h ′ z_{m}^{(r)}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}^{\prime}} .
The memory width d h ′ d_{h}^{\prime} may equal the context width d h d_{h} or differ from it; a learned compatibility projection shared across layers accommodates differing widths.
Together, these choices define the learned PLD (LPLD) predictor g m , t lpld g^{\mathrm{lpld}}_{m,t} .
LPLD uses the attention-aggregated memory z ( r ) z^{(r)} to form keys, whereas the value is taken directly from its m m th patch.

blocks.en:
Storing a separate set of memory patches at each patch position can be redundant, especially given that patchification is an architectural choice.
In ( 10 ) and ( 11 ), the patch-specific memory bank in g m , t lpld g^{\mathrm{lpld}}_{m,t} is replaced with an untied key–value bank { k ( r ) , v ( r ) ∈ ℝ d h ′ } r = 1 R \{k^{(r)},v^{(r)}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{h}^{\prime}}\}_{r=1}^{R} shared across patches and layers.
Coupled with the softmax retrieval, this gives a shared cross-attention (SCA) predictor g t sca g^{\mathrm{sca}}_{t} .
Finally, we replace normalized softmax weights with unnormalized GELU coefficients for a more flexible retrieval rule.
This gives a shared MLP (SMLP) predictor g t smlp g^{\mathrm{smlp}}_{t} .
Absorbing the projection matrices into the keys and values allows SMLP to recover the MLP form ( 8 ).
For all three variants, sharing the memory bank across layers can reduce the parameter count, allowing us to allocate more capacity to predictor heads at matched parameter budgets.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5 实验

blocks.en:
Our experiments examine whether trained DiT denoisers exhibit locality patterns resembling those of the oracle GMRF denoiser (Sec. 5.1 ), and whether, as suggested by our aggregator–predictor framework, layerwise MLPs can be replaced with more interpretable, shared-memory patch predictors (Sec. 5.2 ).
Finally, we use component transplantation to examine whether compatibility patterns among jointly adapted QK, VO, and MLP parameters are consistent with this framework (Sec. 5.3 ).
Experimental details and additional results are in Appendix E .
blocks.zh:
我们的实验研究了训练有素的DiT denoisers是否呈现出类似GMRF denoiser(Sec.5.1)的地方模式,以及如我们的集合器-predictor框架所建议,层层的MLP是否可以被更可解释的共享的补丁预测器所取代(Sec.5.2)。
最后,我们利用组件移植来检查联合调整的QK,VO,和MLP参数之间的兼容模式是否符合这个框架(第5.3节).
实验细节和额外结果载于附录E。

blocks.en: 5.1 Real-image denoising echoes GMRF locality
blocks.zh: 5.1 真实形象的淡化呼应了全球监测成果框架的地方

blocks.en:
Figure 3: Sensitivity-defined contexts broaden with noise, with attention mass showing a related trend. Gold/white contours enclose 50%/95% of normalized squared sensitivity or attention mass; ticks point inward and cyan dots mark target patches.
Right: 95% radii averaged over target patches; Details in Appendix E.2 .

图3:从敏感性定义的上下文随着噪音而扩大,注意力质量显示出相关趋势。 黄金/白色轮廓包含50%/95%的正方形敏感度或注意质量;向内勾选点和青色点标记目标补丁。

blocks.en:
An exact analysis as in Fig. 2 is unavailable for real images.
Instead, we identify context sets using sensitivity weights , which quantify how the prediction of patch m m responds to perturbations of input patch l l , based on a trained DiT’s Jacobian, similar to Niedoba et al. (2025) .
The population denoiser’s Jacobian measures posterior dependence between clean patches given the noisy patches ( Dytso et al., 2021 ) .
Based on these weights, we define the q q -sensitivity radius as the smallest radius of a square centered on patch m m containing at least a fraction q q of the total weight.
The sensitivity context set contains the fewest patches carrying at least that fraction.
blocks.zh:
无法对真实图像进行图2中的确切分析。
我们用灵敏度权重来识别上下文集, 以类似Niedoba等人(2025年),
民众的Denoiser Jacobian衡量干净的补丁之间的依赖性,
基于这些权重,我们定义q q - 灵敏度半径为以补丁 m m为中心的方形最小半径,其中至少包含总权重的一小部分q q.
灵敏度上下文集包含最少带该分数的补丁.

blocks.en:
Denoising sensitivity exhibits GMRF-like broadening; attention shows a related trend. For the synthetic GMRF where the true Jacobian is available, Fig. 2 (c) shows that sensitivity spreads over broader contexts as noise increases.
Denoising real images echoes this pattern: Fig. 3 shows concentrated sensitivity at low noise and broader, sometimes disconnected contexts at higher noise, together with increasing sensitivity radii.
Notably, replacing sensitivity weights with attention mass yields analogous attention contexts and radii, which also generally broaden with noise.
Together, these observations support the GMRF setting as a tractable reference model for denoising locality and the interpretation of attention as an input-adaptive context aggregator.
Sensitivity and attention mass measure different quantities, so the comparison concerns a shared qualitative trend rather than identical context sets.
Additional results appear in Appendix E.2 .
blocks.zh:
降低敏感度显示出类似GMRF的扩展;关注显示出一个相关趋势。 对于有真雅各宾的合成GMRF,图2(c)显示,随着噪音的增加,敏感度在更广泛的背景下传播。
Denoising real images反射了这种模式:图3在低噪声和较大噪声时表现出集中的敏感度,有时在更高噪声时会断开上下文,加上敏感度的增强.
值得注意的是,用注意质量取代敏感度的重量会产生类似的注意背景和光度,而光度也随着噪音而普遍扩大。
这些观测结果共同支持将全球资源框架设定为可操作的参考模型,用于去名地点,并将注意力解释为一个可输入的适应性上下文集合器。
敏感性和注意力量度不同,因此比较涉及共同的质量趋势,而不是相同的上下文。
其他结果见附录E.2。

blocks.en: 5.2 Shared-memory predictors can replace MLPs in a controlled setting
blocks.zh: 5.2 共享模拟预测器可在受控环境下取代磁性半导体

blocks.en:
We replace DiT MLPs with LPLD, SCA, and SMLP on CelebA64.
We compare similar parameter budgets using a common backbone architecture, with modest models and one training seed per configuration for unconditional 64 × 64 64\times 64 face generation.
Figure 4 reports held-out velocity loss, denoising error, and FID at epoch 400.
Three patterns appear; first, the patch-shared SCA and SMLP banks outperform the position-specific LPLD bank at comparable parameter budgets, showing that competitive prediction need not assign separate memory for every patch position.
Second, SMLP improves on SCA, supporting unnormalized GELU retrieval as an effective alternative to softmax.
Third, SMLP with H = 8 H=8 achieves competitive denoising and lower FID than the ordinary MLP, despite sharing its base memory across layers.
Multiple predictor heads generally improve performance, suggesting that multiple projections of the shared bank can be useful.
Together, these results demonstrate that an explicit, layer-shared memory bank can support competitive patch prediction in this controlled setting.
We note that these results by themselves do not establish that layerwise MLP parameters generally encode a single shared memory or that this design transfers unchanged to larger conditional DiTs.
Training details and limitations are in Appendix E.3 .
blocks.zh:
我们用LPLD,SCA和SMLP取代了CelebA64上的DiT MLPs.
我们使用一个共同的骨干架构来比较类似的参数预算,每个配置有适度的模型和一个培训种子,用于无条件的64×6464\times 64面部生成.
图4报告了所持速度损失、消除错误和FID在400世纪的情况。
三种模式出现;首先,补丁共享SCA和SMLP银行在可比参数预算上超过了位置特定的LPLD银行,表明竞争性预测不需要为每个补丁位置指定单独的内存.
其次,SMLP改进了SCA,支持非正常的GELU检索作为软马克斯的有效替代品.
第三,H=8 H=8的SMLP实现竞争性的去诺化和低于普通MLP的FID,尽管其基础内存跨层共享.
多个预测器头一般会提高性能,表明对共享库的多个预测可能有用.
这些结果共同表明,一个清晰的,分层共享的内存库可以支持在此控制环境下的竞争性补丁预测.
我们注意到,这些结果本身并不能确定分层的 MLP 参数一般编码一个共享内存,或这种设计不变地转移到更大的有条件的DiT.
培训细节和限制载于附录E.3。

Figure 5: QK, VO, and MLP component transplants. (a) Source-QK compatibility is higher across spatially similar datasets.
(b) VO reversion costs more as joint non-additivity increases.

blocks.en: 5.3 Component transplants support the aggregator–predictor view
blocks.zh: 5.3 组件移植支持聚合器 - 前置视图

blocks.en:
Transplanting jointly adapted components probes compatibility and coadaptation. To examine compatibility patterns in relation to the proposed component roles, we fine-tune a pretrained source model on a target dataset.
We then transplant combinations of the adapted components into the source checkpoint.
When the datasets have similar spatial structure, our framework suggests that source QK may remain compatible with adapted VO and MLP parameters.
Larger spatial shifts may be associated with stronger coadaptation.
We study twelve transfer directions between face and natural-image datasets.
For clarity, we jointly fine-tune only QK, VO, and MLP, leaving AdaLN and all other parameters fixed, assuming that the learned time conditioning transfers across domains.
Each of the eight resulting hybrids is labeled by QK/VO/MLP bits: 0 for source weights and 1 for jointly adapted weights.
These transplants probe the compatibility and coadaptation of parameters learned jointly; they do not measure the performance obtainable by training QK-, VO-, or MLP-only models.
Separately, under the same target-domain update budget, QK-only and QK+VO-only fine-tuning generally fall further behind joint adaptation on larger domain shifts (Appendix E.4.5 ).
blocks.zh:
移植联合改造的组件探究兼容性和配合性. 为了审查与拟议组成角色有关的兼容性模式,我们在目标数据集上微调了预先训练过的源模型.
然后把经过改造的组件的组合移植到源检点.
当数据集具有相似的空间结构时,我们的框架建议源QK可能仍然与经过调整的VO和MLP参数兼容.
更大的空间变化可能与更强的适应性有关。
我们研究了面部和自然图像数据集之间的十二个传导方向.
为了明确起见,我们只共同微调QK,VO和MLP,让AdaLN和所有其他参数固定下来,假设学到的时间条件可以跨域转移.
产生的8个杂交种中,每个都以QK/VO/MLP比特标注:0表示源重,1表示联合调整后的重量.
这些移植探索了联合学习的参数的兼容性和配合性;它们不测量通过训练QK-,VO-,或只训练MLP模型获得的性能.
另外,在同一个目标域更新预算下,只QK和QK+VO的微调一般会进一步落后于在较大域转移上的联合适应(Appendix E.4.5.

blocks.en:
Following work on patch self-similarity and spatial normalization ( Tumanyan et al., 2022 ; Singh et al., 2026 ) , we measure spatial distance between datasets using MMD 2 of patch self-similarity descriptors.
We compare each hybrid’s outputs with the fully adapted model’s using matched initial noise.
We measure this agreement using DINOv2 global features for endpoint agreement (EA) and patch self-similarity patterns for spatial agreement (SA).
Both scores assign 0 to the source and 1 to the fully adapted model.
Full protocols and results are in Appendix E.4 .
blocks.zh:
继关于补丁自我同质性和空间正常化的工作(Tumanyan等人,2022年;Singh等人,2026年)之后,我们利用补丁自我同质描述符的MMD 2测量数据集之间的空间距离.
我们用匹配的初始噪声来比较每个混合体的输出和完全适应的模型。
我们利用DINOv2全球特征来测量最终点协议(EA)和补丁空间协议(SA)的自我相似性模式。
两个分数都指定0为源,1为完全适应型号.
完整的协议和结果载于附录E.4。

blocks.en:
QK compatibility is higher for spatially similar datasets, while VO reversion penalties track component coadaptation. With source QK retained (011), CelebA → \to AAHQ/FFHQ/AFHQ produces recognizable faces.
In contrast, among the tested CelebA → \to STL-10 hybrids, coherent target-like structure emerges primarily only when all jointly adapted components are present (111; Figs. 1 and 13 ).
Consistent with this pattern, the QK reversion penalty tends to increase with spatial distance (Fig. 5 (a)), which also accompanies stronger component coadaptation (Appendix E.4.3 ).
Additionally, restoring source VO (101) yields fragmented textures in the natural-image-to-face transfers (Figs. 14 and 15 ).
Its reversion penalty increases with joint non-additivity—the gain from joint adaptation beyond the sum of isolated component changes (Fig. 5 (b)).
blocks.zh:
对于空间相似的数据集,QK兼容性更高,而VO重置惩罚轨道组件配合适应. 由于源QK保留(011),CelebA →\to AAHQ/FFHQ/AFHQ产生可辨认的面孔.
相比之下,在经过测试的CelebA →\to STL-10混合体中,一致的目标式结构主要出现于所有联合调整的组件都存在时(111;图1和13)。
与这种模式一致的是,QK还原惩罚往往随着空间距离(图5(a))的增加而增加,这也伴随着更强的组件配合适应(附录E.4.3.).
此外,恢复源VO(101)在自然图像对面转移中产生零碎的纹理(图14和图15)。
其反向惩罚随着共同的非附加性而增加——联合适应的收益超过孤立成分变化的总和(图5(b))。

blocks.en:
Source QK from broader natural-image domains retains partial compatibility on face targets. With source QK retained (011), STL-10 hybrids recover human and animal face structure, including a blurred face for STL-10 → \to CelebA, while joint adaptation produces clearer results (Fig. 14 ).
This contrasts with the poorly formed scene in the reverse CelebA → \to STL-10 direction (Fig. 1 ); additional examples in Appendix E.4.4 .
Figure 5 (c) supports this asymmetry: source QK from STL-10 retains greater endpoint agreement on CelebA than in the reverse direction, while QK from natural-image domains retains partial agreement on face targets at levels comparable to CelebA QK.
blocks.zh:
来自更广泛的自然图像域的源QK在面部目标上保留了部分兼容性. 由于源QK保留(011),STL-10混合体恢复了人和动物的面部结构,包括STL-10 →\to CelebA的面部模糊,而联合适应则产生更明确的结果(图14).
这与反向CelebA →\\to STL-10方向(图1)的形成不良的场景形成对比;附录E.4.4中的其他例子.
图5(c)支持这种不对称性:STL-10的源QK保留了更大的Celeb端点协议. A比反方向,而来自自然图像域的QK在与CelebA QK相当的级别上保留了面部目标的部分协议.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en:
We presented an aggregator–predictor view of diffusion transformers as input-adaptive local denoisers.
Our theory justifies local denoising under GMRF priors and connects patchwise linear denoisers to the empirical local denoising target.
Within this framework, QK determines spatial context weights, VO transports features, and MLPs perform contextualized patch prediction.
Experiments provide complementary evidence through noise-dependent denoising contexts, competitive shared-memory predictors, and cross-domain component compatibility patterns.
Together, these findings offer a statistical and architectural perspective on DiT denoising and motivate further work on interpretable predictors and targeted model adaptation.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了一种聚合器-先导器的观点,将扩散变压器作为可适应输入的本地变压器。
我们的理论认为,在GMRF前言下,局部取消提名是合理的,并将补丁线性取消提名者与当地经验性取消提名目标联系起来。
在此框架内,QK确定空间上下文权重,VO传输特征,MLP进行上下文补丁预测.
实验通过依赖噪声的去诺环境,竞争性的共模预测器,以及跨域组件兼容性模式,提供补充证据.
这些结论共同提供了DiT调试的统计和建筑视角,并激励了可解释预测器和有针对性的模型适应方面的进一步工作。

blocks.en:
Our experiments focus on modest-sized, unconditional DiTs operating on 64 × 64 64\times 64 images across a limited collection of face and natural-image datasets.
In particular, the shared-memory predictor comparison uses CelebA64 with one training seed per configuration, leaving its robustness across datasets, model scales, and training seeds unresolved.
The transfer study examines twelve directions while keeping AdaLN and global parameters fixed; its component transplants probe compatibility among jointly adapted weights and do not uniquely identify the proposed functional roles.
Testing these patterns in larger conditional models, at higher resolutions, and under broader adaptation protocols is an important next step.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验侧重于在64×64 64\时运行的适度大小,无条件的DiTs,通过有限的面部和自然图像数据集的收集,64的图像.
特别是,共享模型预测器比较采用CelebA64,每个配置有一个培训种子,使其在数据集、模型尺度和培训种子之间的稳健性得不到解决。
转移研究审查了12个方向,同时将AdaLN和全球参数固定下来;其组件移植探测了联合调整后的重量之间的兼容性,没有专门确定拟议的功能作用。
在更大的有条件模型中、在更高的分辨率中和在更广泛的适应协议下测试这些模式是下一步的一个重要步骤。

blocks.en: Appendix A Related Literature
blocks.zh: 附录A 相关文献

blocks.en:
Diffusion models learn internal features useful for semantic segmentation and discriminative probing ( Baranchuk et al., 2022 ; Xiang et al., 2023 ) , and semantic and geometric correspondence can emerge without correspondence supervision ( Tang et al., 2023 ) . Chen et al. (2025) connect this ability to classical denoising autoencoders by simplifying diffusion models and studying which components support self-supervised representation learning. Han et al. (2025a) provide theoretical and empirical evidence that denoising encourages representations covering multiple data features, including features that classifiers may neglect.
REPA connects representation quality to generative training by aligning hidden states with pretrained visual features in diffusion and flow-based transformers ( Yu et al., 2025 ) . Singh et al. (2026) further identify the spatial structure of the alignment target as a strong predictor of generation performance.
blocks.zh:
传播模型学习对语义分解和歧视性证明有用的内部特征(Baranchuk等人,2022年;Xiang等人,2023年),语义和几何函证可以在没有函证监督的情况下出现(Tang等人,2023年). 陈等. (2025)通过简化扩散模型和研究哪些组件支持自我监督的表达学习,将这种能力与古典解码自动编码器联系起来. Han et al. (2025a)提供了理论和经验证据,通过去Noing鼓励涵盖多个数据特征的表达,包括分类者可能忽略的特征.
REPA将表现质量与基因培训联系起来,办法是使隐藏状态与传播和流变器中经过预先训练的视觉特征相一致(Yu等人,2025年)。 Singh 等人(2026年)进一步将对齐目标的空间结构确定为生成性能的强预测器.

blocks.en:
Compositional generation provides evidence of reuse: Okawa et al. (2023) demonstrate unseen combinations in a synthetic task, and Favero et al. (2025) analyze the learning of composition rules in a hierarchical grammar, where longer-range dependencies require more data.
The extent of this ability depends on the task; Han et al. (2025b) find that diffusion models can learn coarse relationships while failing finer dependencies, including reflection and lighting consistency.
These findings motivate the introduction’s representation-and-reuse framing.
In our denoising account, a reuse rule has a specific meaning: it determines which context patches supply evidence for predicting a clean patch from a new noisy image.
blocks.zh:
组分生成提供了再利用的证据:Okawa等人(2023年)在合成任务中展现了无形的组合,Favero等人(2025年)在分级语法中分析了组分规则的学习,其中较长距离的依赖性需要更多的数据.
这种能力的程度取决于任务;Han等人(2025年b)发现,扩散模型可以学习粗细的关系,同时缺乏更细的依赖性,包括反射和照明一致性.
这些调查结果推动了导言的表述和重复使用框架。
在我们的去Noising账户中,一个再利用规则有具体的含义:它决定了哪个上下文补丁提供证据,用于从新的吵闹的图像中预测一个干净的补丁.

blocks.en:
Under a finite empirical prior, the squared-error denoising objective is minimized by a weighted average of training images, with weights determined by whole-image comparisons as in ( 2 ).
With the corresponding terminal initialization, exact reverse dynamics recover the empirical distribution ( Pidstrigach, 2022 ; Yoon et al., 2023 ; Gu et al., 2025 ; Biroli et al., 2024 ; Kamb and Ganguli, 2025 ) .
Several explanations address why learned denoisers nevertheless generalize.
Training dynamics can favor generalizing solutions before memorization, with larger datasets delaying memorization ( Bonnaire et al., 2025 ) ; large learning rates can also steer training away from the memorizing solution ( Wu et al., 2025 ) .
Other accounts characterize the learned estimator: Kadkhodaie et al. (2024) connect generalization to geometry-adaptive harmonic representations, while Zhang et al. (2026) prove a distinction between sample storage and balanced representations of local statistics for a two-layer ReLU denoising autoencoder, and investigate analogous structure in larger models.
Our framework concerns how DiT components implement denoising computations compatible with such statistical structure.
blocks.zh:
在有限的以往经验中,用加权平均值的训练图像将平方-偏差去诺目标最小化,加权数由整体图像比较确定,如(2)中。
随着相应的终端初始化,精确的反向动态恢复了实证分布(Pidstrigach,2022;Yoon等人,2023;Gu等人,2025;Biroli等人,2024;Kamb和Ganguli,2025).
有几个解释涉及为什么知识分子还是一般化。
培训动态可以有利于在记忆化之前对解决方案进行概括,较大的数据集会推迟记忆化(Bonnaire等人,2025年);高学习率也可以使培训远离记忆化解决方案(Wu等人,2025年)。
其他说法是学得的估计器的特征: Kadkhodaie 等人(2024年)将概括化与几何适应谐音表示法联系起来,而Zhang等人(2026年)则证明,对于一个双层ReLU去诺化自动编码器,样本存储和均衡的本地统计表示法是有区别的,并在更大的模型中调查了类似的结构.
我们的框架涉及DiT组件如何执行与这种统计结构相符的去名计算。

blocks.en:
Local empirical denoisers explain novel generation through patch recombination. Niedoba et al. (2025) use cropped neighborhoods to approximate trained denoisers; Kamb and Ganguli (2025) derive estimators from locality and translation equivariance; and Lukoianov et al. (2025) choose context from the sensitivity of the optimal linear denoiser, emphasizing the role of data statistics.
These constructions motivate the patchwise linear denoiser (PLD) in Section 2 .
In ( 3 ), a softmax comparison through S m , t S_{m,t} determines how stored training patches x m ( i ) x_{m}^{(i)} contribute to a prediction.
Setting S m , t = I S_{m,t}=I and Γ m , t = σ t − 2 ​ I \Gamma_{m,t}=\sigma_{t}^{-2}I recovers whole-image retrieval; local contexts allow the weights to differ across patches and hence permit recombination.
blocks.zh:
当地的实证代言人通过补丁重组来解释小说一代. Niedoba等人(2025年)利用种植区来估计受过训练的登革斯人;Kamb和Ganguli(2025年)从地方和翻译等效法中得出估计;Lukoianov等人(2025年)从最佳线性登革斯人的敏感性中选择背景,强调数据统计的作用。
这些构造激发了第2节中补丁线性丁二醇(PLD).
在(3)中,通过Sm,t S_{m,t}确定存储的训练补丁xm(i)x_{m}^{(i)}帮助预测.
设置 S m, t = I S_{m, t}= 我和 Γ m, t = σ t → 2 I\Gamma_{m, t}=\sigma_{t}^{-2}我恢复了全图像检索; 本地环境允许不同补丁的权重不同,从而允许重新组合.

blocks.en:
Our statistical contribution identifies a population target for this construction.
Theorem 1 bounds the discrepancy between population local and global denoisers under a GMRF prior.
Theorem 3 identifies when sufficient aggregation lets a PLD recover the empirical local conditional mean exactly; this identity alone is not a finite-sample bound on population risk.
Together, the results motivate learning both the context aggregator and the patch predictor.
The stored patches and context comparisons in the PLD provide an explicit example of content and reuse; Section 4 develops their learned counterparts in a DiT.
blocks.zh:
我们的统计贡献确定了这一建设的人口目标。
定理1将地方人口和全球人口之间的差别限制在GMRF的前身之下。
定理3指出,当充分汇总时,一个人口扩展值能够完全恢复经验性当地条件平均值;仅这一特征本身并不是人口风险的有限样本。
这些结果共同激励人们学习上下文聚合器和补丁预测器。
PLD中存储的补丁和上下文比较为内容和再利用提供了一个明确的例子;第4节在DiT中开发了他们学习的对应物.

blocks.en:
Mei (2025) show how U-Net encoder–decoder paths and skip connections can implement belief-propagation denoising in hierarchical graphical models, providing a direct precedent for interpreting architecture through a statistical denoising algorithm.
For transformers, Rosu et al. (2025) show that attention can implement exact score-based denoising; their image experiments use whole-image tokens, although an anisotropic extension permits patchwise pixel updates. An et al. (2025) associate DiT generalization with local attention in early layers and show benefits from restricting attention windows with limited training data. Gan et al. (2025) link concentrated large feature activations to AdaLN and use channel modulation to improve DiT features for correspondence.
These works explain architectural or conditioning mechanisms relevant to denoising and representation learning.
Our account connects attention, MLPs, and AdaLN through context aggregation followed by patch prediction, allowing context to vary with the input and noise level, including the non-contiguous patterns in Section 5.1 .
blocks.zh:
Mei(2025)展示了U-Net编码器–解码器路径和跳过连接如何在层次图形模型中执行信仰传播代名词,为通过统计代名词代名词算法解释架构提供了一个直接的先例.
对于变压器,Rosu等人(2025年)表明注意可以实施精确的计分解析;他们的图像实验使用全像符,尽管异位扩展允许补丁像素更新. An等人(2025年)将DiT泛化与早期的当地关注联系起来,并显示限制关注窗口与有限的培训数据的好处. Gan等人 (英语). (2025年)链接到AdaLN的集中大特性激活,并使用信道调制来改进DiT的通信功能.
这些作品解释了与去名和代表学习相关的建筑或调节机制.
我们的账户通过上下文汇总,然后是补丁预测,将注意力、MLPs和AdaLN联系起来,使上下文随输入和噪音水平而变化,包括第5.1节中的非毗连模式。

blocks.en:
Language-model MLPs have been interpreted as key–value memories that store and retrieve learned associations ( Petroni et al., 2019 ; Geva et al., 2021 ; Geva et al., 2022 ) ; Sukhbaatar et al. (2019) express them as attention over persistent memory vectors.
This interpretation has motivated locating and editing facts through MLP weights ( Dai et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2023 ) , with related analyses and interventions in multimodal models ( Schwettmann et al., 2023 ; Pan et al., 2024a ; Basu et al., 2024a ; Pan et al., 2024b ) .
At the level of the generative process, Hoover et al. (2023) survey connections between diffusion dynamics and retrieval in energy-based associative memories.
Our DiT account assigns a memory role specifically to the MLP’s patch prediction from aggregated context (Section 4.2 ).
Replacing layerwise MLPs with explicit memory shared across layers tests this interpretation at the level of the predictor component (Section 5.2 ).
The representation may be distributed across learned memory entries; the interpretation does not require individual entries to correspond to named concepts.
blocks.zh:
语言模型的MLP被解释为存储和检索博学协会的钥匙-价值记忆(Petroni等人,2019年;Geva等人,2021年;Geva等人,2022年),Sukhbaatar等人(2019年)将其表达为对持久性记忆向量的注意.
这一解释促使人们通过MLP权重(Dai等人,2022年;Meng等人,2022年;Meng等人,2023年)寻找和编辑事实,并用多式联运模式进行相关分析和干预(Schwetmann等人,2023年;Pan等人,2024年a年;Basu等人,2024年a年;Pan等人,2024年b年)。
在基因过程层面,Hoover等人(2023年)调查了以能量为基础的关联记忆中扩散动力学与检索之间的联系.
我们的DiT账户从集合上下文(第4.2节)中指定了MLP的补丁预测的内存角色。
以分层共享的明确内存取代分层的MLP,在预测器组件一级测试这种解释(第5.2节)。
表示可能分布在学到的内存条目中;解释并不要求单个条目对应命名的概念.

blocks.en:
Several analyses of text-to-image diffusion localize visual attributes in text-encoder self-attention or U-Net cross-attention ( Basu et al., 2024c ; Basu et al., 2024b ) , including neurons associated with concepts or memorized training images ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Hintersdorf et al., 2024 ) .
For DiTs, Zarei et al. (2025) identify blocks associated with specific concepts and use localized updates for personalization and unlearning.
Their component ablations also intervene on self-attention, normalization, and MLP outputs, with cross-attention giving the strongest localization signal in the tested PixArt setting.
Thus, component intervention already has direct precedents in DiTs.
blocks.zh:
对文本到图像的传播进行若干分析,将文本编码器自我注意或U-Net交叉注意中的视觉属性本地化(Basu等人,2024c;Basu等人,2024b),包括与概念或记忆训练图像有关的神经元(Liu等人,2023;Hintersdorf等人,2024).
对于DiTs,Zarei等人(2025年)确定与具体概念相关的块,并使用本地化更新,用于个性化和不学习.
它们的组件还干预了自我注意、正常化和MLP输出,在测试的PixArt设置中,交叉注意发出最强的本地化信号。
因此,组成部分干预在DiTs中已有直接的先例.

blocks.en:
Related editing methods illustrate the practical value of these distinctions.
Custom Diffusion adapts selected parameters for concept customization ( Kumari et al., 2023 ) ; Plug-and-Play Diffusion Features injects spatial features and self-attention to preserve layout during translation ( Tumanyan et al., 2023 ) ; and Shin et al. (2025) analyze text–image attention blocks to design editing interventions for multimodal DiTs. Turri et al. (2026) further show that transferring high-magnitude hidden-state channels between prompt-conditioned trajectories can steer image semantics in DiT and related flow-based models.
These activation interventions complement our parameter transplants, which ask which QK, VO, and MLP computations remain compatible across image domains, guided by the aggregator–predictor account (Section 5.3 ).
The transplants probe jointly adapted components with AdaLN fixed, so their outcomes measure reuse and coadaptation under that intervention protocol (Appendix E.4 ).
blocks.zh:
相关的编辑方法说明了这些区别的实际价值。
自定义传播适应了概念定制的选定参数(Kumari等人,2023年);插件和Play传播特性注入空间特征和自我注意,以便在翻译期间保持布局(Tumanyan等人,2023年);和Shin等人(2025年)分析文本-图像注意块,为多式联运设计编辑干预。 Turri等人(2026年)进一步显示,在快速条件轨迹之间转移高放大隐形通道,可以引导DiT中的图像语义学和相关流基模型.
这些激活干预补充了我们的参数移植,它询问哪些QK、VO和MLP的计算在集成器-predictor账户(第5.3节)的指导下在图像域之间仍然兼容。
移植探测器与AdaLN共同调整了组件固定,因此其结果根据该干预协议(Appendix E.4 )衡量再利用和配合。

blocks.en:
The GMRF prior in Theorem 1 combines joint Gaussian statistics with conditional independence between non-neighboring patches given their graph neighbors.
Markov image models developed from spatial statistics ( Besag, 1974 ) into methods for restoration, texture modeling, and segmentation ( Geman and Geman, 1984 ; Li, 2009 ) , with higher-order models extending interactions to larger neighborhoods and patches ( Roth and Black, 2005 ; Weiss and Freeman, 2007 ; Chen et al., 2014 ) .
Gaussian MRFs ( Rue and Held, 2005 ) have been used for texture modeling ( Chellappa and Chatterjee, 1985 ) , Bayesian restoration ( Shouno, 2015 ; Yasuda et al., 2018 ; Monma et al., 2022 ) , and learned conditional denoising ( Tappen et al., 2007 ) .
The Gaussian optimal denoiser is the Wiener filter ( Wiener, 1949 ; Andrews and Hunt, 1977 ) ; its tractability also supports exact analyses of diffusion sampling ( Pierret and Galerne, 2025 ) and approximations to learned scores at high noise ( Wang and Vastola, 2024 ) .
We use this tractable prior with patches as variables on an arbitrary graph to establish a locality guarantee, and examine the corresponding qualitative patterns on real images separately.

马尔科夫图像模型从空间统计(Besag,1974年)发展为恢复,纹理模型化,分化的方法(Geman and Geman,1984年;Li,2009年),更高顺序模型将相互作用扩展到更大的街区和补丁(Roth and Black,2005年;Weiss and Freeman,2007年;Chen等人,2014年).
Gaussian MRFs(Rue and Held,2005年)被用于纹理模型(Chellappa and Chatterjee,1985年),Bayesian修复(Shouno,2015年;Yasuda等人,2018年;Monma等人,2022年),并学习有条件的去诺(Tappen等人,2007年).
高斯最佳代诺伊泽尔是维纳滤波器(Wiener,1949年;Andrews and Hunt,1977年;其可导性也支持对扩散采样的精确分析(Pierret and Gallerne,2025年),以及高噪音时对学分的近似值(Wang and Vastola,2024年).
我们在任意的图上将这个可带补丁的可拉带作为变量来建立局部保证,并分别检查真实图像上的相应质量模式.

blocks.en:
This section connects the aggregator–predictor construction in Secs. 4 to the implemented architectures.
We first expand a single attention branch applied to the noisy patches Y t Y_{t} , then explain how aggregation and patch prediction extend to residual stacks, and finally give the full predictor parameterizations.
All patches, tokens, embeddings, biases, and aggregates are column vectors, consistent with Appendix B.1 ; projection matrices act from the left.
The width d h d_{h} denotes the full token and aggregate dimension, and the number of attention heads H ~ \tilde{H} divides d h d_{h} .

blocks.en: D.3 Soft locality of Attention Aggregator
blocks.zh: D.3 注意的软位置

blocks.en:
Section D.2 explained how, for fixed features, QK controls the relative logits and hence which patches receive appreciable weight.
Accordingly, low-scoring patches are suppressed smoothly by exponentiation and normalization, rather than removed by a literal threshold.
This provides an input-adaptive analogue of a local selector, but without explicit thresholding unmasked attention remains globally supported and need not solely concentrate on a local context set.

这提供了本地选择器的输入适应模拟,但如果没有明确的阈值,未引起注意的问题仍然得到全球的支持,而且不只需要集中处理本地环境。

blocks.en: D.5 From a single layer to a residual stack
blocks.zh: D.5 联合国 从单层到剩余堆栈

blocks.en:
The construction in Sec. 4 isolates aggregation and prediction in a single layer without residual connections.
In this section, we explain its extension to a residual stack , a multilayer architecture with residual connections.
blocks.zh:
Sec. 4的构造将集合和预测隔离在一个没有剩余连接的单层中.
在这个节中,我们解释它延伸到一个剩余堆栈,一个具有剩余连接的多层架构.

blocks.en:
Let h ℓ h_{\ell} denote the hidden token sequence entering layer ℓ \ell at diffusion time t t .
We absorb normalization, AdaLN, and output gates into the attention branch 𝒮 ℓ , t attn \mathcal{S}_{\ell,t}^{\mathrm{attn}} and the tokenwise predictor g ℓ , t g_{\ell,t} (an MLP in DiT).
The two residual additions give s ℓ \displaystyle s_{\ell} = h ℓ + 𝒮 ℓ , t attn ​ ( h ℓ ) , \displaystyle=h_{\ell}+\mathcal{S}_{\ell,t}^{\mathrm{attn}}(h_{\ell}), h ℓ + 1 \displaystyle h_{\ell+1} = s ℓ + g ℓ , t ​ ( s ℓ ) = h ℓ + 𝒮 ℓ , t attn ​ ( h ℓ ) + g ℓ , t ​ ( h ℓ + 𝒮 ℓ , t attn ​ ( h ℓ ) ) ⏟ F ℓ , t ​ ( h ℓ ) . \displaystyle=s_{\ell}+g_{\ell,t}(s_{\ell})=h_{\ell}+\underbrace{\mathcal{S}_{\ell,t}^{\mathrm{attn}}(h_{\ell})+g_{\ell,t}\!\left(h_{\ell}+\mathcal{S}_{\ell,t}^{\mathrm{attn}}(h_{\ell})\right)}_{F_{\ell,t}(h_{\ell})}. (28) The aggregator interpretation also applies to s ℓ s_{\ell} : it combines the token’s existing state with attention-selected context, so the identity path retains a contribution from the token itself.
The predictor then maps this contextualized state to a residual feature update.

预测器然后将这个背景化状态映射到剩余特性更新.

blocks.en:
We emphasize that ( 28 ) motivates interpreting the residual stack as iterative denoising in feature space : successive aggregation and prediction updates refine the internal residual stream from which the final clean-image estimate is read out.
This view is consistent with interpretations of residual networks as unrolled iterative estimation and feature refinement ( Greff et al., 2017 ; Jastrzebski et al., 2018 ) .
This interpretation also motivates consulting a shared memory across depth, providing a reusable bank of learned representations at each refinement step.
blocks.zh:
我们强调(28)促使将剩余堆栈解释为特征空间的迭代调试:连续的汇总和预测更新完善了内部剩余流,从中宣读了最后的清洁图像估计。
这种观点与对残留网络作为未滚动迭代估计和特征完善的解释是一致的(Greff等人,2017年;Jastrzebski等人,2018年).
这种解释还促使人们深入地咨询共同记忆,在每个改进步骤上提供可重复使用的知识表述库。

blocks.en:
However, the clean factorization in a single layer does not necessarily extend to a residual stack.
Patch projection and positional embedding are applied once at network entry; later layers operate on already contextualized tokens.
Although the shared-channel-operator decomposition of attention still holds layerwise, a token can depend on many original patches, and VO or predictor updates can alter later QK routing.
The division of labor between QK and VO is therefore less clear-cut than in a single layer.
Similarly, the MLP in one layer can affect attention in subsequent layers, and attention can in turn affect subsequent MLP updates.
blocks.zh:
然而,单层的清洁要素化不一定延伸到一个剩余堆栈.
补丁投影和位置嵌入在网络输入时一经应用;后层运行在已经上下文的代号上.
虽然共享通道-操作器的注意力分解仍然按层进行,但一个符号可以依赖许多原始补丁,VO或预测器更新可以改变后来的QK路由.
因此,QK和VO之间的劳动分工不如一个层次的分工清晰.
同样,一个层的MLP会影响后续层的注意力,而注意力又会反过来影响后续的MLP更新.

blocks.en:
We retain CelebA’s official train/test splits and center-crop its images to 178 × 178 178\times 178 before bilinear resizing.
For FFHQ, we retain the official 60,000-image training partition and divide the remaining 10,000 images equally into validation and test sets.
For AAHQ, crops from the same source artwork remain in the same split.
AFHQ-v2 pools all three animal categories, retains the official evaluation split, and removes exact pixel duplicates.
iCartoonFace uses its official train/test splits after filtering invalid crops and exact pixel duplicates; identities may overlap across splits.
STL-10 training combines 100,000 unlabeled images with 4,500 labeled training images, reserving the remaining 500 labeled images for validation and retaining the official test split.
The synthetic GMRF experiment instead uses the analytically specified prior in Appendix E.1 and does not train a DiT.

blocks.en: E.1.3 Sensitivity radius as a measure of statistical dependence

blocks.en:
Along with these exact and certified radii, we define a sensitivity radius based on the input–output Jacobian, which measures how perturbing each observed patch affects the predicted target patch.
For this Gaussian prior, ( J σ ) m ​ l = ∂ D m , σ ∗ ​ ( y ) / ∂ y l (J_{\sigma})_{ml}=\partial D^{\ast}_{m,\sigma}(y)/\partial y_{l} , with J σ = ( I + σ 2 ​ Q ) − 1 J_{\sigma}=(I+\sigma^{2}Q)^{-1} .
We square its entries to measure sensitivity energy and normalize over input patches as ( J σ ) m ​ l 2 / [ ∑ j ( J σ ) m ​ j 2 ] (J_{\sigma})_{ml}^{2}/[\sum_{j}(J_{\sigma})_{mj}^{2}] .
This normalized derivative energy is the fraction of the target m m patch’s total squared sensitivity attributable to input patch l l .
It measures relative influence, so a common reduction in the magnitude of all derivatives does not by itself change the normalized map.
Using this normalization, we define the q q -sensitivity radius : r sns ​ ( m , σ , q ) := min ⁡ { r ∈ ℤ ≥ 0 : ∑ l ∈ B r ​ ( m ) ( J σ ) m ​ l 2 / [ ∑ j ( J σ ) m ​ j 2 ] ≥ q } . \displaystyle r_{\mathrm{sns}}(m,\sigma;q):=\min\left\{r\in\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}:\sum_{l\in B_{r}(m)}(J_{\sigma})_{ml}^{2}\bigg/\left[\sum_{j}(J_{\sigma})_{mj}^{2}\right]\geq q\right\}. (37) The self-patch is included, and we evaluate q ∈ { 0.90 , 0.95 } q\in\{0.90,0.95\} .
Unlike the exact and certified radii, this radius concerns relative derivative energy rather than an absolute locality-error tolerance, so the three radii need not agree.
For any prior with finite second moments, the population denoiser satisfies the posterior-covariance identity ( Dytso et al., 2021 ) ∂ D m , t ∗ ​ ( y ) ∂ y l = σ t − 2 Cov ( X 0 , m , X 0 , l ∣ Y t = y , t ) , σ t > 0 . \displaystyle\frac{\partial D_{m,t}^{\ast}(y)}{\partial y_{l}}=\sigma_{t}^{-2}\operatorname{Cov}(X_{0,m},X_{0,l}\mid Y_{t}=y,t),\qquad\sigma_{t}>0. (38) Thus, its Jacobian reflects the dependence between clean patches that remains after observing the noisy image.
For the Gaussian prior considered here, this Jacobian is independent of y y .

blocks.en:
The third panel shows that the sensitivity radius r sns r_{\mathrm{sns}} can remain broad even when the absolute locality error becomes small.
As noise increases from low levels, a larger graph neighborhood is needed to capture the same fraction of the total derivative energy, consistent with the initial growth of r ext r_{\mathrm{ext}} and r crt r_{\mathrm{crt}} .
At extreme noise, however, the absolute response to every observation weakens, while its relative contribution approaches a constant: ( J σ ) m ​ l 2 ∑ j ( J σ ) m ​ j 2 ⟶ ( ( Q − 1 ) m ​ l ) 2 ∑ j ( ( Q − 1 ) m ​ j ) 2 as ​ σ → ∞ . \displaystyle\frac{(J_{\sigma})_{ml}^{2}}{\sum_{j}(J_{\sigma})_{mj}^{2}}\longrightarrow\frac{((Q^{-1})_{ml})^{2}}{\sum_{j}((Q^{-1})_{mj})^{2}}\qquad\text{as }\sigma\to\infty. (39) At extreme noise, the posterior covariance approaches the prior covariance Q − 1 Q^{-1} , while the factor σ − 2 \sigma^{-2} in the Jacobian makes its absolute entries vanish.
This common scale cancels under normalization, leaving a pattern determined by the prior’s covariances, which can extend to distant patches.
These results show why a broad sensitivity radius can coexist with a small absolute locality error: the radius describes the distribution of influence, while the error also depends on its absolute strength.
Note that in this synthetic setting, we do not claim that the sensitivity radius must increase monotonically with noise, or that observations outside the corresponding neighborhood can be removed without affecting denoising accuracy.

blocks.en:
This interpretation provides a link to denoisers trained on real-image datasets: their input–output Jacobians also describe responses to infinitesimal perturbations, so the sensitivity radius r sns r_{\mathrm{sns}} can be defined in the same way to characterize local functional context even when the population prior and exact local conditional means are unknown.
Furthermore, due to ( 38 ), to the extent that learned denoisers approximate the population denoisers, their Jacobian-based sensitivity provides a measure of statistical dependence relevant to denoising.

blocks.en: E.2 Experiment 1-2: Denoising context in DiTs trained on real-image datasets
blocks.zh: E.2 实验1-2:在DiTs中进行关于真实图像数据集的培训

blocks.en:
We ask whether the denoising-relevant statistical dependence in image datasets exhibits a similar pattern to the exponentially local GMRF model studied in Appendix E.1 .
We use trained DiTs as estimators of the population denoiser and its Jacobian; through the posterior-covariance identity ( 38 ), their sensitivity fields provide an empirical view of this dependence.
We use a DiT with approximately 20M parameters, comprising L = 10 L=10 transformer layers, token dimension d h = 320 d_{h}=320 , H ~ = 10 \tilde{H}=10 attention heads, and MLP hidden width 1280.
We denote its clean-patch prediction by D m , t dit D_{m,t}^{\mathrm{dit}} and use the common patch representation and training protocol at the start of Appendix E .
Following the normalized-observation convention in Sec. 2 , D m , t dit ​ ( y ) D_{m,t}^{\mathrm{dit}}(y) denotes the prediction obtained by feeding t ​ y ty and t t to the trained network; thus, all input derivatives below are with respect to y y .

blocks.en: E.2.1 Sensitivity context set based on input-output Jacobian
blocks.zh: E.2.1 基于投入-产出的敏感性上下文

blocks.en:
Our primary measurement is the Jacobian of output patch m m with respect to input patch l l , extending the scalar-patch sensitivity in Appendix E.1 .

(40) Since each patch contains multiple spatial and color coordinates, we measure its sensitivity by the squared Frobenius norm of this block, which sums the squared derivatives over all input–output coordinate pairs.
The squared Frobenius norm extends the squared scalar Jacobian entries used in Appendix E.1 to vector-valued patches.
This also follows the use of input-gradient sensitivity to study denoiser locality in Niedoba et al. (2025, Sec. 3.1) .

Together, these quantities distinguish spatially broad context from sparse influence carried by a few distant patches.
The posterior-covariance identity ( 38 ) connects these measurements to statistical dependence remaining after observing the noisy image.
Under the Jacobian approximation described above, these sensitivity-based contexts estimate the patches carrying most of the expected squared posterior cross-covariance with the target.
They thus characterize the dataset’s denoising-relevant dependence through a learned predictor.

(44) Each attention row sums to one over source patches, so ∑ l w m ​ l attn ​ ( t ) = 1 \sum_{l}w_{ml}^{\mathrm{attn}}(t)=1 without further normalization.
We average the softmax weights themselves, without squaring them or weighting them by residual gates or value/output projections; this measures how attention distributes mass across token positions along the residual stream.

blocks.en: E.2.3 Interpretation of Fig. 3
blocks.zh: E.2.3 图3的解释

blocks.en:
Figure 3 reveals a pattern of denoising-relevant statistical dependence similar to that of the synthetic GMRF prior.
Sensitivity is concentrated at lower noise, while its radius generally increases as noise grows, echoing the broadening of relative sensitivity in Fig. 2 .
Through the posterior-covariance interpretation in ( 38 ), this suggests that predicting a patch relies on a broader set of statistical dependencies when the observation is noisier.
Figures 7 and 8 corroborate this overall broadening across additional datasets and at both 90% and 95% coverage curves.
The analytic GMRF setting thus provides a useful model for interpreting the estimated dependence fields of real-image datasets, beyond its role as a tractable synthetic example.
blocks.zh:
图3显示了一种与以前合成的GMRF相似的去名相关的统计依赖性模式。
灵敏度集中在较低的噪声上,而它的半径一般随着噪声的增加而增加,与图2中相对灵敏度的扩大相呼应.
通过(38)中的后向-共性解释,这表明在观测是噪声时,预测补丁依赖于更广泛的一组统计依赖.
图7和图8证实,这一总体范围在新的数据集中有所扩大,覆盖曲线分别为90%和95%。
因此,分析的GMRF设置提供了一个有用的模型,用以解释真象数据集的估计依赖性领域,超出了它作为可牵引合成实例的作用。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Sensitivity and attention radii and patch counts on four datasets. Solid/dashed curves show 90%/95% coverage, computed from population maps over 1,024 held-out images and averaged over all 256 target patches.
blocks.zh: 图7 敏感度和注意力度 辐射度和补丁值计有四个数据集。 固态/凹陷曲线显示覆盖率为90%/95%,从1,024张悬浮图像的人口地图计算,平均覆盖所有256个目标补丁。

blocks.en:
The estimated dependence fields in the heatmaps show that patches carrying most of the sensitivity can form irregular or disconnected regions rather than a centered square.
At lower noise, influence is concentrated near the target and selected nearby structures; at higher noise, the displayed context sets spread over a larger part of the image.
The radius and patch count therefore describe complementary aspects of context: its spatial extent and the number of patches carrying a specified fraction of influence.
blocks.zh:
热图中估计的依赖字段表明,携带大部分敏感度的补丁可以形成不规则或断开的区域,而不是一个中心方块.
在低噪音下,影响集中在目标附近和选定的附近结构;在高噪音下,显示的上下文集分布在图像的较大部分.
因此,半径和补丁计数描述了上下文的互补方面:其空间范围以及带有指定一小部分影响的补丁数量.

blocks.en:
Head- and layer-averaged attention also tends to spread over a broader region at higher noise, although its mass is already more diffuse than sensitivity at low noise.
Attention weights and input–output Jacobians are different quantities: the former are softmax-normalized logits between intermediate tokens, whereas the latter measure how the final denoised prediction responds to the original input.
There is therefore no requirement that their spatial patterns agree.
Their observed agreement in overall broadening is consistent with attention adapting its aggregation to the dataset’s denoising-relevant dependence structure and contributing to the formation of noise-dependent local context, as suggested by the aggregator interpretation in Sec. 4.1 and Appendix D.5 .
The additional radius/count curves and heatmaps in Figs. 7 and 8 support this interpretation.
Note that the comparison concerns a shared qualitative trend rather than equality of context sets: 95% attention mass and 95% squared derivative energy describe different distributions.
blocks.zh:
头和地层平均注意力也往往以较高的噪音分布在更大的区域,尽管其质量已经比低噪音时的敏感性更加分散。
注意权重和输入量-输出量 雅各比亚是不同的量:前者是中间符号之间的软马克思常态对数,而后者则衡量最终的去声预测如何响应原始输入.
因此,没有要求它们的空间格局同意。
它们所观察到的在全面扩大方面的一致意见与注意力是一致的,即使其汇总适应数据集的消音相关依赖结构,并促进形成依赖噪音的局部环境,如第4.1节和附录D.5中的汇总解释所示。
Figs中额外的半径/计数曲线和热图. 7和8支持这一解释。
请注意,这一比较涉及的是共同的质量趋势,而不是上下文的等值:95%的注意力质量和95%的平方衍生能量描述了不同的分布。

blocks.en: E.3 Experiment 2: Replacing MLPs with shared-memory predictors
blocks.zh: E.3 实验2:用共享模型预测器取代 MLP

blocks.en: E.3.1 Motivation
blocks.zh: E.3.1 动机

blocks.en:
Our aggregator–predictor framework decomposes the local conditional mean into a local aggregator and a patch predictor (Def. 2 ).
Sections 4.1 and 4.2 associate these operations with attention and the DiT MLP, respectively.
This interpretation motivates replacing the MLP with more interpretable predictors based on retrieval from a reusable bank of learned representations, as introduced in Sec. 4.2 , with the aim of attaining comparable denoising and generative performance at a similar trainable-parameter budget.
If the proposed alternatives were to fail to do so, this would indicate that their representation or training omits useful properties of an ordinary MLP for denoising.
Conversely, a successful replacement provides evidence that the framework supports a useful, explicitly structured alternative.
Additionally, this comparison lets us examine the effects of three design choices on empirical performance: patch-specific versus patch-shared storage, softmax cross-attention versus unnormalized GELU retrieval, and a base memory shared across layers versus independent layerwise memory.
We take a baseline DiT and replace only its patch predictor with an alternative predictor, leaving everything else fixed; the following section provides the details.
blocks.zh:
我们的聚合器- predictor 框架将本地条件平均值分解为本地集合器和补丁预测器( Def 2 ) 。
第4.1节和第4.2节分别将这些行动与DiT MLP联系起来。
这种解释促使人们根据从可重复使用的知识表述库中提取的可解释性更强的预测器取代MLP,这是第4.2节提出的,目的是在类似的可训练参数预算中实现类似的去诺化和基因化性能。
如果拟议的替代品未能做到这一点,这将表明其代表或培训省略了普通的MLP的去名特性。
相反,一个成功的替代提供了证据,证明框架支持一种有用的、明确结构的替代办法。
此外,通过这一比较,我们可以审查三种设计选择对经验性能的影响:特定补丁对共享补丁存储的影响,软马克思交叉意向对非正常的GELU检索的影响,以及分层共享的基础内存对独立的层层内存的影响.
我们取一个基线的DiT,只用一个替代的预测器来替换它的补丁预测器,让其他的一切都固定下来;下面一节提供细节.

blocks.en: E.3.2 Settings
blocks.zh: E.3.2 设置

blocks.en:
We use the CelebA splits, preprocessing, and common training protocol described at the start of Appendix E , without horizontal-flip augmentation.
All models use token width d h = 256 d_{h}=256 , depth L = 8 L=8 , and H ~ = 8 \tilde{H}=8 spatial-attention heads.
The patch embedding, spatial-attention architecture, AdaLN conditioning, residual structure, and image-output head are common across families.
Each model is trained jointly from initialization; the common backbone specification does not mean that attention weights are frozen or shared between runs.
blocks.zh:
我们使用附录E开头描述的 CelebA 拆分,预处理,和共同训练协议,不进行水平-flip增强.
所有型号均使用符号宽dh=256 d_{h}=256,深度L=8 L=8,H~=8\tilde{H}=8 空间注意头.
补丁嵌入、空间注意结构、AdaLN调制、剩余结构以及图像输出头等在家庭间很常见。
每个模型都是从初始化开始联合训练的;共同的骨干规格并不意味着注意力重量被冻结或运行之间共享.

blocks.en:
We use the implementations in Appendix D.4 , with the residual composition in Appendix D.5 .
Table 3 lists all 21 configurations.
For each shared-memory family, we compare H = 1 H=1 and H = 8 H=8 predictor heads at the same stored width, with projected width d h / H d_{h}/H per head.
Thus, the total projected query, key, and value width stays at 256 rather than growing eightfold with the number of heads.
We vary stored width d h ′ d_{h}^{\prime} and choose MLP hidden widths to obtain three approximate parameter budgets around 8.6–8.9M, 10.2M, and 13.0–13.4M parameters.
The table reports exact counts, including the common backbone and all predictor parameters; matching is approximate, rather than exact equality or equal computation.
blocks.zh:
我们采用附录D.4中的执行,剩余构成则采用附录D.5。
表3列出了所有21种配置.
对于每个共享记忆家族,我们比较H=1H=1,H=8H=8的预测器头,存储宽度相同,预测宽度为dh/Hd_{h}/ 每头H.
因此,预测的查询、密钥和数值宽度总数仍为256,而不是随着头数增长8倍。
我们的存储宽度不尽相同,选择了MLP隐藏宽度,以获得大约8.6-8.9M、10.2M和13.0-13.4M参数的三项参数预算。

blocks.en:
For training, we use the common objective in Eq. ( 30 ) and train all configurations to 400 epochs, with 5,086 optimizer updates per recorded epoch and 2,034,400 updates in total.
The global batch size is 32, and the default learning rate is constant except for the LPLD recovery intervention below.
All runs use training seed 0.
blocks.zh:
在培训方面,我们使用Eq. (30)中的共同目标,将所有配置训练到400个纪元,每个纪元记录有5 086个优化更新,总共更新2 034 400个。
全球批量规模为32,默认学习率保持不变,但下文LPLD恢复干预除外.
所有运行使用训练种子0.

blocks.en:
Table 3: Complete patch-predictor grid. Each numeric entry in the last two columns specifies one trained configuration.
All models use d h = 256 d_{h}=256 , L = 8 L=8 , and H ~ = 8 \tilde{H}=8 ; predictor head width is 256 for H = 1 H=1 and 32 for H = 8 H=8 . R R counts image-shaped memories for LPLD, shared prototype pairs for SCA/SMLP, and hidden units for MLP.
blocks.zh:
表3:完整的补丁前置网格. 最后两列中的每个数字条目都指定一个训练好的配置.
所有型号使用dh=256 d_{h}=256,L=8 L=8,H~=8\tilde{H}=8;预测头宽256 H=1 H=1,32 H= 8 H=8 (韩语). R R计算LPLD的图像形状记忆,SCA/SMLP的共享原型对,以及MLP的隐藏单元.

blocks.en:
LPLD’s key path applies spatial attention to each of the R R full memory grids at every layer and noise level.
This is substantially more expensive than projecting a patch-shared prototype bank: distinct sampled times require distinct conditioned memory computations.
We therefore draw four independent times per global batch and share each time among eight images, retaining independent Gaussian noise for each image.
This allows the memory-key computation to be reused within a time group, while leaving per-image marginal objective in Eq. ( 30 ) unchanged.
blocks.zh:
LPLD的密钥路径将空间注意力应用于每个层和噪声层的R全内存网格.
这比预测一个补丁共享原型库要贵得多:不同的抽样时间需要不同的有条件内存计算.
因此,我们每个全球批量绘制四个独立时间,并且每次分享八幅图像,为每幅图像保留独立的高斯噪音。
这使得内存键计算可以在一个时间组内被重用,同时让Eq. (30)中的每个图像边际目标保持不变.

blocks.en:
During training, the original H = 8 , d h ′ = 256 H=8,d_{h}^{\prime}=256 LPLD run developed severe generation artifacts and degraded denoising during training.
We exclude that run from the displayed comparisons and use a separate recovery that resumes its epoch-225 checkpoint, including optimizer and EMA state, at learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} .
The recovery reaches cumulative epoch 400 after 175 additional epochs and has FID 29.197 at that endpoint.
Only completed post-restart measurements are drawn for its trajectory; they are not spliced onto the original curve.
blocks.zh:
训练期间,原H=8,dh=256 =8,d_{h}^{\prime }=256 = LPLD经营开发了严酷的一代工艺品,并在培训期间退化了消音.
我们从所显示的比较中排除了这种情况,并使用单独的恢复,恢复其划时代的-225检查站,包括优化器和EMA状态,学习率10 - 4 10 - 4 Q 4 。
恢复达到175个新纪元后累计达到400个纪元,并在该端点有FID 29.197.
仅对其轨迹绘制完成的重新启动后测量数据;这些测量数据没有在原曲线上铺设。

blocks.en:
All measurements use EMA weights and the same 19,962 held-out test images.
We evaluate the velocity objective above and the raw, unclipped clean-image MSE across 32 logarithmically spaced normalized noise levels σ ∈ [ 0.05 , 4 ] \sigma\in[0.05,4] .
The denoising score is the trapezoidal integral of this MSE with respect to log ⁡ σ \log\sigma , divided by log ⁡ ( 4 / 0.05 ) \log(4/0.05) , so it is an average error over the specified noise range.
At each noise level we use t = 1 / ( 1 + σ ) t=1/(1+\sigma) to map the normalized observation to the model’s input convention.
FID-50k compares 50,000 generated samples with the common real-test feature statistics.
Generation uses 50 uniform time intervals from noise to data, with Heun updates and an Euler update on the last interval, and the same denominator floor of 0.05.
We evaluate the standard training trajectories every 25 epochs.
Figure 4 uses epoch 400 for every displayed metric and model in the current snapshot, rather than selecting each model’s best intermediate FID.
blocks.zh:
所有测量都使用EMA权重和相同的19,962个搁置测试图像.
我们评估上面的速度目标以及32个对数空间的正态噪声水平的原始、未剪切的清洁图像MSE。
解析分数是此MSE中与log \\\log\sigma相关的tapezoidal 组件,除以log {}\log(4 / 0.05)\log(4/ 0.05),因此它是指定噪声范围的平均错误.
在每一个噪声级别上,我们使用 t = 1 / (1 + σ) t = 1 / (1 + σ sigma)来将常态观测图映射到模型的输入常规.
FID-50k将5万个生成的样本与常见的实测特征统计进行比较.
世代使用从噪声到数据50个统一的时间间隔,在上一个间隔上加Heun更新和Euler更新,同分母底座0.05.
我们每25个纪元评估标准训练轨迹。
图4对当前快照中显示的每个度量衡和模型使用划时代400,而不是选择每个模型的最佳中间FID。

blocks.en: E.3.3 Results and interpretation
blocks.zh: E.3.3 结果和解释

blocks.en:
Figure 9 shows that all reported families learn substantial denoising improvements, but their attained errors and generation trajectories differ.
Held-out losses generally decrease smoothly, whereas FID is less monotone.
The following comparisons use the common epoch-400 snapshot in Fig. 4 .
blocks.zh:
图9显示,所有报告的家庭都学习了大幅度的无名化改进,但它们所取得的错误和生成轨迹各不相同。
搁置损失一般平稳减少,而FID的单酮较少。
以下比较使用图4中常见的划时代-400快照.

blocks.en:
Figure 9: Training trajectories for the patch-predictor comparison. Held-out velocity loss, denoising log- σ \sigma AUC MSE, and FID-50k on CelebA64.
Colors identify predictor families; circles and triangles indicate H = 1 H=1 and H = 8 H=8 .
Solid, dashed, and dotted curves denote increasing d h ′ d_{h}^{\prime} within each shared-memory family, or increasing hidden width R R for MLP.
blocks.zh:
图9:补丁-前导比较的培训轨迹. Hold-out electric lost, denoing log - \\sigma ACUC MSE,以及CelebA64上的FID-50k.
颜色表示预测家族;圆形和三角形表示H=1H=1,H=8H=8.
固体、破碎和圆点曲线表示每个共同记忆家族内增加d h ' d_{h}^{\prime ,或增加MLP的隐藏宽度R。

blocks.en:
The patch-shared SCA and SMLP banks are more competitive than LPLD’s position-specific image-shaped memory in the corresponding parameter-budget groups.
At the largest budget with H = 8 H=8 , LPLD has denoising AUC 0.013087 and FID 19.848, compared with 0.012873 and 17.145 for SCA, and 0.012777 and 15.767 for SMLP.
Thus, allocating a separate stored value vector to every patch position is not necessary for competitive denoising in this setting.
Sharing prototypes across positions permits a much larger bank—1,024 entries rather than 32—at a similar total parameter count.
Overall, the weaker LPLD results show that the most literal learned-image retrieval construction is not automatically the easiest or most effective mechanism for patch predictor.
blocks.zh:
补丁共享SCA和SMLP银行在相应的参数预算组中比LPLD的特定位置图像形状存储器更具竞争力.
在H=8 H=8的最大预算中,LPLD取消了AUC 0.013087和FID 19.848,而SCA为0.012873和17.145,SMLP为0.012777和15.767。
因此,为每个补丁位置分配一个单独的存储值矢量对于在此设置中进行竞争性调试是不必要的.
共用各职位的原型可以使银行规模大得多——1 024个条目,而不是32个,其参数总数类似。
总体来说,LPLD的较弱的结果表明,最字面的学习-图像检索构造并非自动成为补丁预测器的简单或最有效的机制.

blocks.en:
At every tested ( H , d h ′ ) (H,d_{h}^{\prime}) pair, SMLP has lower held-out velocity loss, denoising AUC, and FID than SCA.
For example, at H = 8 , d h ′ = 512 H=8,d_{h}^{\prime}=512 , SCA and SMLP have FIDs 18.413 and 16.652, respectively, with denoising AUCs 0.012882 and 0.012716.
Although SCA already includes the positive, query-dependent headwise gain η ℓ , h , t ​ ( s ) \eta_{\ell,h,t}(s) specified in Appendix D.4 , its within-head softmax coefficients remain nonnegative and coupled by normalization.
In contrast, GELU allows unnormalized, potentially signed coefficients, providing a more flexible way to combine the shared values.
The observed advantage is consistent with this flexibility being useful during training.
blocks.zh:
在每一次测试(H, dh ) (H, d_{h}^{\prime)对试时,SMLP的牵引速度损失率都比SCA低,去Noing AUC,以及FID.
例如,在H = 8, d h = 512 H = 8, d_{h}^{\prime }=512中,SCA 和 SMLP 分别有 18.413 和 16.652 的FID, 并取消AUC 0.012882 和 0.012716.
虽然SCA已经包括了附录D.4中规定的正的、依赖查询的头部增益 {l、h、t(s)\eta_{\ell、h、t}(s),但其头部内软度系数仍然是非负的,并伴之以正常化。
相比之下,GELU允许非常态的,可能签名的系数,提供了更灵活的方式将共享的值结合起来.
所观察到的优势与这种灵活性在培训期间有用是一致的。

blocks.en:
Holding the stored width fixed, H = 8 H=8 improves both held-out denoising measures over H = 1 H=1 at every tested width in all three shared-memory families.
For SCA and SMLP, it also improves FID at every width.
For example, at d h ′ = 1024 d_{h}^{\prime}=1024 , increasing H H from one to eight reduces FID from 22.508 to 17.145 for SCA and from 19.556 to 15.767 for SMLP.
LPLD FID improves from 29.269 to 27.167 at d h ′ = 128 d_{h}^{\prime}=128 and from 24.976 to 19.848 at d h ′ = 512 d_{h}^{\prime}=512 .
This suggests that multiple projections of the shared bank can be useful while keeping the total projected width fixed.
blocks.zh:
H = 8 H = 8 持有存储宽度可以改善所有三个共享模组家庭中每个测试宽度H = 1 H = 1 的屏蔽消音措施。
对于SCA和SMLP,它也会在每个宽度上改进FID.
例如,在dh = 1024 d_{h}^{\prime }=1024中,将H从SCA的22.508降至17.145,将FID从19.556降至15.767。
LPLD FID在dh = 128 d_{h}^{\prime = 128,在dh = 512 d_{h}^{\prime = 512 的LPLD FID改进为27.167.
这表明,共享银行的多重预测在保持总的预计宽度固定的同时可能有用.

blocks.en:
The central comparison is between SMLP, whose base key–value bank is reused at every layer, and the ordinary MLP, whose vectors are independently stored in each layer.
For H = 8 H=8 SMLP at d h ′ ∈ { 256,512 , 1024 } d_{h}^{\prime}\in\{256,512,1024\} , epoch-400 FIDs are 15.017, 16.652, and 15.767, compared with 19.550, 17.574, and 16.060 for the respective MLP controls.
At the smallest budget, their denoising AUCs are 0.0127499 and 0.0127496, and their velocity losses are 0.076336 and 0.076360.
At the middle and largest budgets, SMLP has approximately 0.24% and 1.33% higher denoising AUC, respectively, despite its lower FID.
Thus the shared-memory predictor is competitive in both denoising and generation, with a small denoising tradeoff at the larger budgets.
We emphasize that the result is a constructive demonstration that independently stored memory at every layer is not required for this level of performance.
blocks.zh:
中心比较是在SMLP和普通的MLP之间,SMLP的基础键 - 值库在每个层被重复使用,而普通的MLP,其矢量独立存储在每个层中.
H = 8 H = 8 SMLP at d h ' { 256,512, 1024 } d_{h}^{\prime}\in \{256, 512, 1024 \}, epoch-400 FID为15.017, 16.652, 和 15.767, 而MLP各自控制为19.550, 17.574和16.060.
在最小的预算中,他们的取消提名的AUC是0.0127499和0.0127496,其速度损失是0.076336和0.076360.
在中等和最大预算中,尽管美国联合自卫军的自学率较低,但该军的自学率分别为0.24%和1.33%。
因此,共同记忆预测器在去名和代词方面都具有竞争力,在较大的预算方面有少量去名取舍。
我们强调,结果是一种建设性示范,不要求将内存独立储存在每一层才能达到这一水平。

blocks.en:
We close by noting the scope of this experiment.
It is a controlled study of unconditional face generation at 64 × 64 64\times 64 resolution, with modest model sizes and one training seed per configuration.
These limits constrain how broadly the findings of our experiment can be applied.
We therefore do not claim that all DiT MLPs should share memory.
Instead, the results support considering an explicit shared memory architecture when a common representation bank would be useful for inspection or future intervention.
Our experiment shows that this architecture is feasible at least in the setting studied here.
blocks.zh:
我们最后注意到这一试验的范围。
它是以64×64 64\times 64分辨率对无条件面部生成进行控制研究,每个配置有适度的模型尺寸和1个训练种子.
这些限制制约了我们试验结果的应用范围。
因此,我们并不声称所有DiT MLP应该共享记忆.
相反,结果支持考虑建立明确的共享记忆架构,因为共同代表库将有助于检查或今后的干预。
我们的实验表明,这种建筑至少在研究的环境下是可行的.

blocks.en: E.4 Experiment 3: Component compatibility in cross-dataset adaptation
blocks.zh: E.4 实验3:跨数据集适应中的组件兼容性

blocks.en:
The aggregator–predictor framework separates forming a patch’s local context from predicting its clean value using learned representations.
Section 4.1 associates the first operation with attention and Sec. 4.2 associates the second with the MLP.
Experiment 1 finds that DiT sensitivity and attention maps exhibit related noise-dependent broadening on real images; Experiment 2 shows that explicit retrieval from a shared memory supports competitive denoising and generation quality in a controlled CelebA64 study.
We now ask whether component compatibility across image domains is consistent with the proposed attention and MLP roles.
This question also matters when target data or adaptation compute are limited: fine-tuning methods must decide which pretrained parameters to update, and the best choice can depend on the source and target distributions ( Kumari et al., 2023 ; Choi et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
集合- predictor 框架将构成补丁的本地背景与用学到的表达来预测其清洁价值分开。
第4.1节对第一次行动给予注意,第4.2节对第二次行动给予注意。
实验1发现,DiT灵敏度和注意度图在真实图像上表现出相关的依赖噪声的拓宽;实验2显示,从共享内存中明确的检索支持在受控的CelebA64研究中具有竞争性的去诺和生成质量.
我们现在询问,图像域的组件兼容性是否与拟议的关注和MLP的作用一致。
当目标数据或适应计算有限时,这个问题也很重要:微调方法必须决定哪些经过预先训练的参数可以更新,最佳选择可以取决于源和目标分布(Kumari等人,2023年;Choi等人,2024年).

blocks.en:
The attention decomposition in ( 7 ) gives a more specific hypothesis.
Within an isolated branch, QK controls spatial weights and VO transforms and transports features; the MLP admits a key–value representation for tokenwise updates.
This motivates the hypothesis that source QK may remain compatible with adapted VO and MLP parameters when source and target have similar spatial context, with larger shifts associated with reduced compatibility.
Source-QK compatibility may also be directional: a broadly trained source may support contextual relations needed by a narrower target, whereas the reverse transfer need not hold.
We probe these hypotheses by adapting QK, VO, and MLP jointly to each target, then replacing one or more adapted groups with their source weights without further optimization.
The eight resulting hybrids show how much each subset of jointly learned changes matters for reproducing the jointly adapted model.
blocks.zh:
(7)中的注意分解给出了一个更具体的假设.
在一个孤立的分支内,QK控制空间权重和VO的转换和运输特征;MLP承认一个按键值的表示,用于象征性的更新.
这激发了一种假设,即当源与目标具有相似的空间背景时,源QK可能仍然与经过调整的VO和MLP参数兼容,与兼容性降低相关联的转移较大.
源-QK兼容性也可能是方向性的:一个经过广泛培训的源可能支持范围较窄的目标所需要的背景关系,而反向转移则不需要持有.
我们通过将QK,VO,和MLP共同适应每个目标来探究这些假设,然后用一个或多个适应组的源重来替换它们,而不进一步优化.
由此形成的八种杂交体显示了每个子集共同学习的改变对于复制联合改编的模型的重要性.

blocks.en:
We use the 20M-class DiT of Appendix E.2 on 64 × 64 64\times 64 RGB images: L = 10 L=10 , d h = 320 d_{h}=320 , H ~ = 10 \tilde{H}=10 , and MLP hidden width 1280.
The twelve directions are CelebA → \to AAHQ/FFHQ/AFHQ-v2/STL-10, STL-10 → \to AAHQ/FFHQ/AFHQ-v2/CelebA, and ImageNet64 → \to AAHQ/FFHQ/AFHQ-v2/CelebA.
Source training uses seed 0; adaptation starts from EMA checkpoints at source epochs 400, 800, and 800, respectively, and is repeated with two adaptation seeds.
Only the attention QK and VO projections along with MLP block weights are updated jointly.
Patch, position, and time embeddings, AdaLN, the output head, and other parameters stay fixed.
Freezing AdaLN keeps its learned time conditioning while holding the denoising schedule constant; it assumes that this aspect of time dependence transfers across datasets.
blocks.zh:
我们在64×64 64\时使用附录E.2的20M级DiT,64RGB图像:L=10 L=10,dh=320 d_{h}=320,H~=10\tilde{H}=10,MLP隐藏宽度1280.
12个方向是CelebA →\AAHQ/FFHQ/AFHQ-v2/STL-10,STL-10 →\AAHQ/FFHQ/AFHQ-v2/CelebA,和ImageNet64 →\AAHQ/FFHQ/AFHQ-v2/CelebA.
源头培训使用0号种子;改造从源头的EMA检查站开始,分别为400、800和800,并用两个改造种子重复。
只有注意QK和VO的预测与MLP块重量一起共同更新.
补丁,位置,和时间嵌入,AdaLN,输出头,以及其他参数保持不变.
冻结AdaLN在保持调试时间表不变的同时,保持其学习的时间安排;它假定时间依赖的这一方面跨越数据集转移。

blocks.en:
Training uses the common VP objective, global batch 32, AdamW with learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , and a fresh optimizer for adaptation.
For source and target training-set sizes N src , N tgt N_{\mathrm{src}},N_{\mathrm{tgt}} , one reference epoch is s ref = min ⁡ ( ⌊ N src / 32 ⌋ , ⌊ N tgt / 32 ⌋ ) s_{\mathrm{ref}}=\min(\lfloor N_{\mathrm{src}}/32\rfloor,\lfloor N_{\mathrm{tgt}}/32\rfloor) updates; adaptation stops by 200 reference epochs, with checkpoints every 25.
For each direction, we select the checkpoint minimizing the joint model’s two-seed mean FID-50k on the monitored target split, with earlier epochs breaking ties, and use that same reference epoch for both seeds (Table 4 ).
Each eight-state hybrid cube uses the selected checkpoints, EMA weights, and the same 1,024 Gaussian initial latents per state, sampled in FP32 with 50-step VP Heun.
Note that since the three architectural components are adapted jointly, these eight-state swaps measure compatibility among jointly adapted components; they do not measure what independently fine-tuned restricted models could learn.
blocks.zh:
训练使用共同的VP目标,全球第32批,AdamW,学习率2×10−4 2\times 10×4},以及新的优化适应器.
对于源与目标训练设置大小 N src, Ntgt N_{\mathrm{src}}, N_{\mathrm{tgt}}, 一个参考时代是 s ref = min ⁡ (  N src / 32 , ⌊ n tgt / 32⌋) s_{\mathrm{ref}}=\min (\底) n_{\mathrm{src}}/32\rdle,\llade N_{\mathrm{tgt}}/32\rdle) 更新; 适应停止200个参考时代,每25个检查站.
对于每个方向,我们选择检查点将联合模型的两种子平均FID-50k在被监测的目标分裂上最小化,早期的时代断裂了联系,并且对两种种子都使用同样的参考时代(表4)。
每个八国杂交立方体使用选定的检查站,EMA重量,以及相同的每州1,024高斯亚初始潜伏物,在FP32中取样,有50步VP Heun.
请注意,由于三个建筑构件是联合改造的,这些八态互换可以衡量联合改造构件之间的兼容性;它们不能衡量独立微调的限制性模型能够学到什么.

blocks.en:
Component transplantation diagnoses compatibility among parameter groups obtained by joint adaptation; it neither determines their performance when optimized in isolation nor uniquely assigns computation to components in a multilayer residual network.
Separate restricted-training comparisons are reported in Appendix E.4.5 .
Spatial MMD, EA, and SA are descriptive proxies for dataset geometry and endpoint agreement, not direct measurements of denoising context.
The twelve transfer directions share datasets and pretrained sources, and the component contrasts share cube terms; their correlations are descriptive rather than independent-sample estimates of a population relationship.
blocks.zh:
组件移植诊断通过联合调整获得的参数组之间的兼容性;它既不在单独优化时决定其性能,也不在多层剩余网络中单独指定组件进行计算.
附录E.4.5报告单独的限制性培训比较。
空间MMD,EA,和SA是数据集几何和端点协议的描述性代词,而不是直接测量去诺化上下文.

blocks.en: E.4.1 Spatial MMD for dataset similarity
blocks.zh: E.4.1 数据集相似性的空间MMD

blocks.en:
To describe spatial similarity between unpaired real-image datasets, we compare distributions of whole-image patch self-similarity descriptors using maximum mean discrepancy (MMD).
For an individual clean image x 0 x_{0} , let u m ​ ( x 0 ) u_{m}(x_{0}) be its final DINOv2 ViT-B/14 feature at patch position m m after square resize to 224 × 224 224\times 224 , yielding a 16 × 16 16\times 16 patch grid ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) .
For each feature channel, subtract its mean over the 256 patch positions and divide by its spatial sample standard deviation plus 10 − 6 10^{-6} ; then normalize each patch vector to unit length, obtaining u ^ m ​ ( x 0 ) \widehat{u}_{m}(x_{0}) .
For patch positions m , l ∈ [ 256 ] m,l\in[256] , we form K x 0 ​ ( m , l ) = u ^ m ​ ( x 0 ) ⊤ ​ u ^ l ​ ( x 0 ) K_{x_{0}}(m,l)=\widehat{u}_{m}(x_{0})^{\top}\widehat{u}_{l}(x_{0}) and let v ⁡ ( x 0 ) ∈ ℝ 32640 v(x_{0})\in\mathbb{R}^{32640} collect the upper off-diagonal entries of K x 0 K_{x_{0}} in a fixed raster order.
Thus each descriptor retains where pairs of patches have similar features.
Patch self-similarity has been used to describe image structure ( Tumanyan et al., 2022 ) , and spatially normalized patch features have been studied in diffusion representation alignment ( Singh et al., 2026 ) ; applying MMD to these descriptors for cross-dataset comparison is our construction.

blocks.en: E.4.5 Training trajectories and restricted fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 页:1 培训轨迹和有限的微调

blocks.en:
We compare joint QK/VO/MLP fine-tuning (111) with training all parameters from scratch and with independent fine-tuning restricted to QK or QK+VO, using the same target-domain update budget (Figs. 16 – 18 ).
Joint fine-tuning is comparable to or better than scratch training in held-out denoising and usually in FID-50k; STL-10 → \to CelebA is an exception for FID at the selected joint endpoint.
QK-only and QK+VO-only fine-tuning generally lag further behind on larger domain shifts under the tested training protocol and update budget.
Each target has one row, with denoising AUC, VP velocity loss, and FID-50k in columns; lower is better.
The two loss axes use 10 − 2 10^{-2} units, as in Fig. 9 .
Solid and dashed curves denote adaptation seeds 0 and 1, and dotted scratch curves use seed 0.
Vertical lines mark the selected joint endpoints; source pretraining is excluded from the target-domain update count.
